questions.cardText:
[Psychology] What does the size of a person’s signature often correlate with in terms of personality traits?
A. Aggressiveness
B. Self-esteem
C. Extroversion
Answer: B. Studies have shown that larger signatures generally indicate higher self-esteem and confidence. Some studies have also shown that larger signatures reflect one’s dominance and, among female participants, narcissism.
questions.de: Welche Persönlichkeitseigenschaft signalisiert laut einer Studie von 2016 eine größere Unterschrift bei Männern wie Frauen (Narzissmus dagegen nur bei Frauen)?
questions.en: According to a 2016 study, which personality trait do larger signatures signal in both men and women (and narcissism only among women)?

timeline.labelEn: Mailhos and colleagues publish “Signature size signals sociable dominance and narcissism”
timeline.labelDe: Mailhos und Kollegen veröffentlichen die Studie „Signature size signals sociable dominance and narcissism“

source.title: A bigger signature correlates with social bravado and narcissism

questions.notes: The card's answer (self-esteem) is contradicted by the 2016 study its own explanation describes (Mailhos et al., Journal of Research in Personality): signature size correlated with sociable dominance in both sexes and narcissism among women, but NOT with self-esteem or aggressive dominance. Asked the study's finding instead.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the most abundant element in the Earth’s crust?
A. Aluminum
B. Silicon
C. Oxygen
Answer: C. Oxygen makes up about 46.6% of the Earth’s crust by weight and 94% of it by volume. It is usually bonded to other elements, forming minerals and making up rocks.
questions.de: Welches ist das häufigste chemische Element der Erdkruste, das fast die Hälfte ihrer Masse ausmacht?
questions.en: What is the most abundant element in the Earth’s crust, making up almost half of it by weight?

timeline.labelEn: Joseph Priestley isolates oxygen (discovered independently by Carl Wilhelm Scheele, c. 1771–1773)
timeline.labelDe: Joseph Priestley isoliert Sauerstoff (unabhängig davon von Carl Wilhelm Scheele um 1771–1773 entdeckt)

source.title: Abundance of elements in Earth's crust

questions.notes: Wikipedia's table gives 46.1% by mass for the continental crust; the card's 46.6% is another common estimate.
